title: Document comments: Word and Excel comments on the phone

steps.path: A Word document or spreadsheet opened on the phone
steps.headline: Should Word and Excel comments work on the phone in this first version?
steps.today: You signed that tapping a commented cell on a phone opens its comment. The technical plan found that reading and saving comments inside Word and Excel files can only run in the desktop app as planned.
steps.problem: Keeping the promise means building the Word and Excel comment reading and saving a second time for the phone, which makes the first version bigger. Regular documents and code files work on the phone either way.

options.label: Full support on the phone
options.summary: Read, add, reply and resolve Word and Excel comments on the phone too.
pros: Keeps the promise you signed; the phone behaves exactly like desktop.
cons: Roughly two to three more build tasks, and a second copy of the riskiest code (writing into Word and Excel files) to test.

options.label: Read-only on the phone
options.summary: The phone shows Word and Excel comments and lets you open them, but adding, replying and resolving happen on desktop.
pros: Tapping a commented cell still opens its comment, as signed.
Only reading is duplicated, which is the low-risk half.
cons: On the phone, the reply box on a Word or Excel comment is replaced by a note saying replies are desktop-only.

options.label: Desktop only for now
options.summary: The phone says Word and Excel comments are not available on this device yet; a later project adds them.
cons: Breaks line 7 of what you signed for spreadsheets.
Highlights you left on desktop are invisible on the phone for those two file types.
